title: Flapjacks
description: Traditional British flapjacks made with just oats, golden syrup and butter — toffee-like on top and crumbly in the middle. Sliced into chunky triangles.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C/160°C fan, and butter and line two small round cake tins (20cm across).
Melt the butter with the syrup in a saucepan over a medium heat, removing from the hob before the mixture starts to bubble. Pour over the oats in a large bowl and mix thoroughly.
Press the mixture down into the cake tins tightly with the back of a spoon until flat and even.
Bake for approximately 30 minutes until golden on top.
While still hot, use a sharp knife to score each tin into twelve triangular pieces. Allow to cool completely in the tins before removing.
notes: Makes 24 flapjacks. Per flapjack estimate. For dairy-free, replace butter with the same weight of melted coconut oil.
